title: Blush Framework media metadata
description: A media file's metadata, kept in user/data/media: the built-in fields (alt is for images). Sites and extensions add their own.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema editors check this file with.

title.description: What the library calls it, in place of its file name.

alt.description: Alt text: What the image shows, for anyone who can't see it.

caption.description: Shown with the file where it's used, such as under an image.

credit.description: Who made it, or where it's from.

description.description: A longer description, for the library.

sizes.description: An image's other sizes: each file's path in user/media, with its width and height. media:sizes records them.

id.description: The media file's id, a UUID, kept last. Blush writes it; media:ids adds a missing one.
